decisions.reason: The rejection is correct: R_E(g,z)=zg has the nontrivial diagonal Z_3 kernel {(omega I_3,omega^-1):omega^3=1}, and the original connection backgrounds also fix this constant kernel. Thus the unrestricted spectrum S={E} did not meet the cited p=0 effectiveness clause. The repaired data explicitly admit independent, nondynamical probes in (3,0) direct-sum (1,+1). Their action is faithful on the complete compactly supported probe domain, while the functional, counterterms and anomaly problem remain in the original connection-background subalgebra; arbitrary finite S and the fixed product H are retained.
